facts.fact: Minister Jacques Sosthene Dingara said the basic-education and digital-transition ministries are working to make the electronic unique identifier the root of the national pupil file, which is to be populated from it.
Sidwaya reports the head of state officially launched enrolment in the electronic unique identifier twelve days before the basic-education ministry began enrolling its own staff on 23 November 2026.
